clog.definition:
n. footwear usually with wooden soles
n. any object that acts as a hindrance or obstruction
v. become or cause to become obstructed
v. dance a clog dance
clog.translation:
n. 障碍, 脚坠
v. 障碍, 阻塞

clog dancing.translation: 木鞋舞, 木屐舞（clog dance的现在分词）

clog on equity of redemption.translation: [法] 妨碍衡平法上的赎回权

clogged.definition:
s. thickened or coalesced in soft thick lumps (such as clogs or clots)
s. loaded with something that hinders motion

cloggers.translation: (clogger 的复数) n. 木屐匠

cloggies.definition:
plural of cloggy
s (used of soil) compact and fine-grained
cloggies.translation: (cloggy 的复数) a. 易粘住的, 多块的

clogginess.definition: n. The state of being clogged.

cloggs.translation: (clogg 的第三人称 -s形式)  [人名] 克洛格

cloggy.definition: s (used of soil) compact and fine-grained
cloggy.translation: a. 易粘住的, 多块的

clogs.definition:
n footwear usually with wooden soles
n any object that acts as a hindrance or obstruction
n a dance performed while wearing shoes with wooden soles; has heavy stamping steps
v become or cause to become obstructed
v dance a clog dance
v impede the motion of, as with a chain or a burden
v impede with a clog or as if with a clog
v coalesce or unite in a mass
v fill to excess so that function is impaired
clogs.translation:
n. 木屐; 木底鞋, 木屐( clog的名词复数 )
v. （使）阻碍( clog的第三人称单数 )
